name: Laura Ross
source:
Laura is the main protagonist’s - Harry’s - girlfriend, and works at the same company as him. She is the team leader of the creative department. She’s conscientious, kind hardheaded, and firm, although she’s become softer ever since she started going out with Harry.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/54313248]Patreon[/url]]
